output.review_comment: The implementation now uses banker's rounding (round to even index) to pass the tests, but the docstring still says "rounds up to the later one." These contradict: 09:15 with 30-min slots should round to 09:30 (later) per the docstring, but the code rounds it to 09:00 (earlier). Since the teammate stated "docstrings are the source of truth," either (1) update the docstring to document banker's rounding behavior, or (2) fix the implementation to always round to the later boundary when exactly halfway. The docstring must be kept in sync with the implementation's actual behavior.
